intro.zh: formatPrice 把“分”变成价格：1234 变成 $12.34。但 5 分会显示成 $0.5，应该是 $0.05。
intro.en: formatPrice turns cents into a price: 1234 becomes $12.34. But 5 cents shows as $0.5 and should be $0.05.

zh: 小数点后永远是两位，不够就在前面补 0。
原来就对的价格保持不变。
en: Always two digits after the point, padded with a leading 0.
Prices that were already right stay the same.

hint.zh: format-price.js 里的 rest：用 .padStart(2, '0') 补到两位。
hint.en: The rest variable in format-price.js: pad it to two digits with .padStart(2, '0').

hiddenTests.title: card 02: the cents part is always two digits
card 02: prices that were right stay right
